name: Pridewing Venom Sac
summary: Around Mirkfallon Lake, pridewing venom draws the attention of Astranaar’s night elves. Reports say Horde agents gather it for covert attacks, and the Sentinels seek to deny them that poison.

sections.title: A Threat in the Crags
sections.body: Pridewings hunt the crags south of Ashenvale, especially near Mirkfallon Lake. Though native to the Stonetalon Mountains, these flying predators range here, and their venom lies in glands within their bodies. Reports from Theramore say Horde assassins use the poison to coat blades for secret strikes on night elf settlements. So Astranaar’s Sentinels send scouts to hunt the wyverns and collect their glands before Horde agents can claim them.

faq.q: What creatures yield a Pridewing Venom Sac?
aliases: where to get pridewing venom sac
faq.answer: Young pridewings, skyhunters, patriarchs, and consorts near Mirkfallon Lake yield the venom sacs.

faq.q: Why does Astranaar want Pridewing Venom Sacs?
faq.answer: Shindrell Swiftfire has reports that Horde agents use pridewing poison on weapons for silent attacks against the Alliance. Taking or destroying the glands can prevent those strikes.

faq.q: Who accepts these venom sacs in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: In Astranaar, the night elf town in Ashenvale, Shindrell Swiftfire collects the venom sacs to protect her people from covert attacks.

faq.q: Are the pridewings naturally allied with the Horde?
faq.answer: No. The pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake are wild beasts, not willing allies of the Horde. Orc agents exploit their venom for warfare.

angles.text: Denying Horde agents pridewing venom helps protect frontier patrols from unseen assassins along the contested borders of Stonetalon and Ashenvale.
As a night elf, you may regret that innocent wild beasts must be hunted. Still, protecting elven lives from poisoned blades comes first.
